reason: Hypothesis B is more physically sound and specific: it correctly identifies a continuous, dense Al₂O₃ scale as the protective mediator, cites relevant evidence that alumina is an excellent barrier up to ~1300°C, and sets a realistic test temperature of 1100°C within that range, whereas Hypothesis A proposes 1200°C without support and makes an unjustified quantitative claim of 2–3× improvement.
